BiblicalUsage: tsᵉphar is the word the Bible uses when it means a bird. In Daniel 4:12, the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and it appears again in Daniel 4:14.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsᵉphar still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
